title: a placement is not the file's word
line: the brother an obituary names, placed beside its subject as a child of the couple, is linked to his parents by that placement alone: the person screen calls each link undecided, never the file's claim, his overview card names no parent the file claims, his parents fact rests on records nobody has accepted, and the queue, which takes a parent the file names before the card's own person, takes neither parent at his card
